charts.title: LHS 1903 b: orbits around LHS 1903
charts.description: The orbits of LHS 1903's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LHS 1903 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Wilson et al. 2026 (2026Sci...392l2348W), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname WILSON_ET_AL_2026): P 2.1555098 d

charts.title: LHS 1903 b: its transit
charts.description: LHS 1903 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (20, 47, 60) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 318022259, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
